COMPLETE · 64/64 episodes · raw receipts: results/r5/nominal/

Same frozen weights and seed within each comparison. Ambient includes the rest of the Mac; loaded adds one 1024² MLX matmul worker. Injected delay is a separate stress scenario. Age percentiles pool applied actions across the fixed horizon, including after car termination; raw/summary JSON also separates active-task age. Coverage and misses count dropped and unfinished frames. No wins are inferred from latency alone. Small seed counts limit generalization.

Car: 10 Hz sensors, ≤10 ms integration, strict walls, 40 s timeout. Tracker: 30 Hz, 40 frames, 90 px/s pursuit cursors; error includes startup and occlusion. Requested Core ML units can fall back to CPU. Every raw receipt contains uptime, battery/power and stage timings.
